title: Netherlands: Dutch Government Faces Growing Pressure Over Defence Costs and Household… · 26 Aug
keywords: Netherlands, defence spending, NATO, Dutch budget, inflation, fiscal policy, De Nederlandsche Bank, European defence, cost of living, 2027 budget, Dutch politics, coalition government, EU fiscal policy
notes: The Netherlands is grappling with a deepening fiscal dilemma as the cabinet pushes to raise defence spending toward 3.5% of GDP by 2035, even as households continue to feel the strain of elevated inflation. Critics say the government has yet to identify a credible funding path for its security ambitions, raising the prospect of hard trade-offs in the 2027 budget cycle. The outcome will matter beyond Dutch borders, as the Netherlands is widely watched as a test case for how European states fund defence without losing public consent.
